updates.explanation: Promulgated Article 6 enacts AltZertG § 2a(1)–(2): effective costs, measured as reduction in contractual return by the Annex VI total-cost methodology, at most 1.0% for § 1(1c) standard depots. § 1(1c) provides two risk-class fund options, a default contribution split if the saver does not choose, and scheduled de-risking to at most 50% in the higher-risk fund five years before payout and 30% two years before/at payout. The saver can request other percentages. Article 14(2) starts Article 6 on 1 January 2027. This resolves the exact future-rule access gap.
updates.limits: It is an enacted future rule for the proposed 2027 scheme, not an October 2026 already-operative requirement. The ceiling is effective-cost reduction in yield, not a simple annual cash-fee maximum; preset lifecycle percentages can be changed by the saver. It does not guarantee a loss-free product.

evidence.locator: AnnexVI contract entry/distribution/recurring costs and total-cost indicator; explicitly labelled official indexed extraction

updates.explanation: The factual cost-coverage component is now supportable for acquisition/distribution costs charged within the standard-depot contract. Future § 2a(1) covers costs reducing the contract return and expressly incorporates the total-cost indicator. Official Annex VI indexed text includes entry/distribution/marketing cost categories and aggregates one-off, recurring and incidental costs into the return-reduction measure. A separate acquisition/distribution cost ban is legally different from an aggregate ceiling.
updates.limits: Do not infer that a 1% ceiling makes a ban unnecessary or assures equal effective access to every distribution model; those are policy/effect claims. The rule does not automatically capture every independently billed third-party advisory fee outside the contract, and PRIIPs disclosure itself flags possible extra seller/adviser fees. The author’s paragraph concerns the product-contract charge prohibition, which defines this supported scope. Exact independent web retrieval was challenged; indexed official methodology is explicitly labelled.
